verdict: Chipotle grew revenue 7.4% to $3.1B as transactions turned positive again, but profit fell 22% to $303M as labor, food and a biennial managers' conference pushed costs up faster than sales.

kpis.label: Restaurant-level margin
kpis.note: of revenue, at the store level; 23.7% adjusted

segments.name: Food and beverage revenue
segments.note: Burritos, bowls and drinks across 4,090 company-owned restaurants. Digital orders were 38.6% of this revenue, and 49 new restaurants opened in the quarter — 42 of them with a Chipotlane drive-thru.

segments.name: Delivery service revenue
segments.note: Delivery fees Chipotle collects on orders placed through its own app and website — a sliver next to the food itself.

flow.costPlain: Everything it costs to run the restaurants themselves: food, beverage and packaging ($913M), crew labor ($805M), occupancy ($170M) and other operating costs ($481M).

opex.name: General and administrative
opex.note: Running the company above the restaurant level — headquarters, marketing and support, including the biennial All Managers Conference held this quarter.

opex.name: Depreciation and amortization
opex.note: Spreading the cost of restaurant build-outs, equipment and technology.

opex.name: Pre-opening costs
opex.note: Costs to open new restaurants before they serve their first burrito bowl.

opex.name: Impairment and closure costs
opex.note: Writing down or closing underperforming locations, and disposing of assets.

follow100Note: Three-quarters of every $100 never leaves the restaurant — ingredients, crew and rent eat it on site. Rows may not add exactly due to rounding.

takeaways.title: Transactions turned positive
takeaways.text: Comparable sales rose 0.5% — transactions up 0.6%, partly offset by a 0.1% smaller average check — the first positive transaction comp after a soft 2025. Digital sales were 38.6% of food and beverage revenue.

takeaways.title: 49 new restaurants opened
takeaways.text: Chipotle opened 49 company-owned restaurants (42 with a Chipotlane), reaching 4,090 company-owned and 14 partner-operated locations. Full-year guidance was for about flat comparable sales and 350–370 openings.

takeaways.title: Margins squeezed at the restaurant
takeaways.text: Restaurant-level margin fell to 23.3% from 26.2% as labor rose to 26.1% of revenue (including legal costs) and food, beverage and packaging rose to 29.6% on beef and freight inflation. Operating margin fell to 12.9% from 16.7%.

oneTimers: Adjusted net income of $316.2M excludes $17.6M of items: $11.9M of legal-proceeding costs in labor, $0.6M of legal costs in G&A, $2.1M of Recipe for Growth restructuring costs and $3.0M of retention stock pay.
G&A of $203.7M included the biennial All Managers Conference, held in the first quarter of 2026.
Chipotle repurchased $700.8M of its own stock in the quarter at an average of $36.14; about $1.0B of buyback authorization remained at March 31.
otherDetail: Interest and other income, net, was $8.7M — mostly interest earned on Chipotle's cash and investments.
footerNote: Chipotle doesn't report gross profit; the middle step is its own 'restaurant-level operating profit' — revenue minus the four costs of running the restaurants.
pngFooterNote: The middle step is Chipotle's restaurant-level operating profit.
